title: Intervention-Conditioned Counterfactual Human Digital Twin Generator
abstract: arXiv:2610.40664v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Chronic diseases evolve through long, heterogeneous trajectories shaped by interacting mediators, confounders, and treatment histories. Estimating long-term patient trajectories under alternative interventions is essential for in silico clinical trial design. However, most existing models overlook irregular visit intervals and cross-mediator dependencies, both of which are crucial for reliable long-term longitudinal prediction. Moreover, these models typically focus on outcome prediction rather than generating complete patient-state trajectories. To address these challenges, we propose CHDT, an intervention-conditioned Human Digital Twin generator under standard identification assumptions for multimodal longitudinal trajectory estimation. Its main empirical advantage arises from explicit modeling of irregular visit intervals, while cross-mediator refinement provides additional gains in selected intervention-conditioned settings. translated_title: 干预条件下的反事实人类数字孪生生成器
translated_abstract: 慢性疾病通过漫长且异质性的演化轨迹发展，这些轨迹受到相互作用的介导变量、混杂因素和治疗历史的共同塑造。在替代干预方案下估计患者的长期轨迹，对于计算机模拟临床试验的设计至关重要。然而，现有大多数模型忽略了不规则的就诊时间间隔以及跨介导变量之间的依赖关系，而这两者对于可靠的长期纵向预测都至关重要。此外，这些模型通常专注于结果预测，而非生成完整的患者状态轨迹。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了CHDT——一个在标准可识别性假设下、以干预为条件的人类数字孪生生成器，用于多模态纵向轨迹估计。其主要实证优势来自对不规则就诊时间间隔的显式建模，而跨介导变量的精细化处理则在特定干预条件设置下带来了额外收益。
tldr: 提出CHDT，一个干预条件下的反事实人类数字孪生生成器，通过显式建模不规则就诊间隔和跨介导变量依赖关系来生成完整的多模态患者纵向状态轨迹，服务于计算机模拟临床试验设计。
en_tdlr: Proposes CHDT, an intervention-conditioned counterfactual Human Digital Twin generator that explicitly models irregular visit intervals and cross-mediator dependencies to generate complete multimodal longitudinal patient-state trajectories for in silico clinical trial design.
